integrity: All stated nonzero equilibria are classified algebraically. Exact characteristic polynomials and rational Routh-Hurwitz inequalities are reproducible with the embedded SymPy checker; no floating-point sign decision is used.
scientific_limitations: Autonomous fixed-anchor two-agent system only; the full equilibrium census and the symmetric linear-stability threshold are general in positive rates, while the triple local attraction is certified only at the stated exact parameters. Local attraction need not establish accessibility for the constrained physical initial-opinion plane; no global convergence, empirical prediction, or external independent verification is claimed. The full text of a related but structurally different 2021 study was unavailable.
title: Exact symmetry-breaking threshold and three attracting states in a two-agent opinion–leadership model
